scenes.headline: Google just launched an AI agent\nthat keeps working after you log off.
scenes.body: It’s called Gemini Spark — and it’s now rolling out in India.

scenes.headline: This is not just another chatbot.
scenes.body: Spark can keep working in the background even when your laptop is closed or your phone is locked.

scenes.headline: What can it actually do?
scenes.body: Track tasks, scan information, work across Gmail, Docs and Sheets, and keep scheduled workflows running for you.

scenes.headline: Example for professionals
scenes.body: Ask it to review your inbox every Monday, pull the important updates, build a priority list and help block time for deep work.

scenes.headline: The bigger shift
scenes.body: AI is moving from answering questions to taking actions across your workflow — under your direction.

scenes.headline: Who gets it in India?
scenes.body: Google says Spark is available to AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, with rollout expanding across supported users.

scenes.headline: Would you trust an AI to run work in the background?
scenes.body: Follow @buildwith_pankaj for practical AI updates that matter at work.

captions.text: AI THAT WORKS AFTER YOU LOG OFF
NOT JUST CHAT — IT TAKES ACTION
